sasha: FYI repro for a weird stream hang when cancelling an async generator right after an auth refresh. Seen on 0.8.2 SDK.
ben: repro please? steps/logs/snippet would help. :eyes:
sasha: minimal snippet below — reproduce with our example app + simulated 401 refresh token flow. generator never yields final EOF and socket stays open.
```
async def stream_chat():
    async for chunk in client.responses.stream("...prompt..."):
        yield chunk

# client does token refresh in background when 401 received
# then caller calls `agen.aclose()` after cancellation
```
alison: I saw something similar when using FastAPI background tasks — the background canceller calls `await aclose()` and the worker gets stuck on `recv` instead of raising CancelledError.
matt: hypothesis: token refresh does a retry/read that leaves the HTTP connection mid-chunk, our async generator finalizer doesn't drive the socket to EOF, so uvloop keeps it open. also typing: AsyncIterator[bytes] vs AsyncGenerator[str, None] mismatch in signatures might hide aclose in some call sites.
ben: can you paste the debug logs around the time of cancel? especially httpx/anyio traces.
sasha: logs (trimmed):
```
INFO  auth: refresh start
INFO  transport: recv 1024 bytes
INFO  auth: refresh complete
WARN  stream: cancel request received
DEBUG transport: waiting on read() -> never returns
```
jordan: quick ask: are we cancelling from a thread that holds the event loop? e.g., sync-to-async bridge? that can suppress CancelledError.
alison: nope, pure async in uvicorn workers. also occurs with asyncio.run in unit tests.
matt: workaround for now: call `await client.responses.stream(...).__anext__()` in try/except and then explicitly `await agen.aclose()` inside finally. ugly but forces underlying read to close. we should expose a context manager: `async with client.responses.stream(...) as s:` to guarantee cleanup.
ben: filing feature request + bug. can someone add a small isolated repro test and mark as blocking for 0.9?
sasha: created repro gist: https://gist.github.com/sasha/stream-cancel-repro (contains minimal server that returns 401 mid-stream)
jordan: also request: improve typing for stream() to return AsyncContextManager[AsyncIterator[str]] so editors and mypy suggest `async with`.
matt: agree — SDK should provide both `stream()` that is async iterator and `stream_cm()` or make it context manager. devex/eng-runtime to triage. @eng-runtime please assign.
ben: added issue #2476 with labels: bug, stream, auth-refresh, regression. linking gist and logs.
sasha: putting a short repro into CI as flaky test to catch regressions. will follow up with patch aligning finalizer to call transport.close on aclose.
jordan: thanks — saved my afternoon. :pray:
dev-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 (low) linked to #2476.
